backupRecoveryPoint.evidence: Railway Pro plan enabled 2026-09-28; PostgreSQL continuous backup (pgbackrest) provisioned on the production database service. Deployment logs confirm: stanza-create completed, a full backup completed successfully (full backup size = 31.2MB, file total = 1374), pgbackrest-watcher reported a PITR anchor emitted, catalog verification confirmed the full backup present in remote S3-compatible storage, and continuous WAL archiving is healthy (10+ segments archived, failed=0, gap_state=clear). Verified via mcp__Railway__get-service-config (WAL_ARCHIVE_* variables and clusterRole: root present) and mcp__Railway__get-logs filtered for backup/pgbackrest/archive/WAL on the production Postgres service.

restoreVerification.evidence: No disposable restore test has yet proven recovery from the production backup source. backupRecoveryPoint confirms a valid, current recovery point exists; restoreVerification still requires provisioning a separate disposable Postgres service from that PITR point and validating recovered data before this gate can be marked verified.

cutover.reason: backupRecoveryPoint is now verified with real pgbackrest evidence. Do not switch backend Dockerfile paths/artifact sources until candidateImageSmoke and restoreVerification are also verified.
